estimates.assumptions: 1 large orange (approx 280g whole with peel); puree includes nearly all edible peel and flesh; standard USDA values scaled to full fruit quantity
300g caster sugar (pure sucrose; all used in batter)
280g plain white flour (standard all-purpose; all incorporated)
1 tbs (approx 12g) baking powder; typical sodium aluminum sulfate or phosphate-based values for full quantity
4 large eggs (approx 200g total edible without shells; negligible carbs from raw eggs in batter)
2 tsp (approx 8-10g) vanilla extract; typical alcohol-based extract values for full amount
